$what: Real GuitarSet recording (Bossa Nova comping, 119 BPM, G key (I-V-vi-iii-IV: G/D/Em/Bm/C)), E:minor chord, 1.2s window starting 0.3s after JAMS segment onset (instance 1 of this root+quality across all prepared sources).

recordingMeta.$licenseNote: GuitarSet (Xu, Q., Salamon, J., Bittner, R., Wang, X., Bello, J.P. "GuitarSet: A Dataset for Guitar Transcription", ISMIR 2018), Zenodo record 3371780, CC BY 4.0 — verified 2026-08-18 (docs/research/2026-08-18-w1-audio-golden-fixture-kaynaklari.md). Source ZIP entries SHA-256-pinned in tool/fetch_guitarset_fixtures.py.

expected.$chordDerivation: JAMS "chord" namespace, structurally-selected simple/coarse track (no "/" in any event value — the detailed voicing track, e.g. "D#:sus2(7)/1", was deliberately excluded: ChordDetector only models {major,minor,dominant7}, so grading against extensions/inversions would test a question it never claims to answer). Root mapped via JAMS "<root>:<quality>" split; ChordTemplate.name for major has NO suffix, minor gets an "m" suffix (chord_detector.dart ChordTemplate.name) — chroma.dart pitchClassNames are all-sharp, matching JAMS Harte notation directly for this take, no enharmonic conversion needed here (though the flat→sharp table above exists for future files that might use flat spellings).

windowing.$rationale: ChromaAnalyzer.minWindowMs=200 (chroma.dart) is the analysis floor; a 400ms window / 200ms hop yields 5 flush non-overlapping-start windows across this 1200ms clip, testing whether the chord reading is STABLE across the held sustain (a real reliability question) rather than accepting a single lucky sample.

labels.$annotatorSource: JAMS annotation_metadata.data_source on the simple chord namespace.
